items.title: 1.5.3 Using UML to Represent Software Systems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of using UML (PDF 24-25).

blocks.text: UML software development ke mukhtalif marahil mein samajh aur rabta behtar karne ke liye istemal ho sakti hai.

items: Planning: code likhne se pehle UML diagrams se nizam ki requirements aur design ka naqsha banana.
Development: developers nizam ki banawat aur rishte samajhne ke liye UML diagrams dekhte hain.
Communication: UML diagrams team ke arkaan, ghair technical stakeholders samet, ko samjhate hain ke nizam kaise kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Coding se pehle UML ka ek istemal aur development ke doran ek istemal bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Coding se pehle UML requirements aur design ka naqsha banati hai; development ke doran programmers nizam ki banawat aur rishte samajhne ke liye diagrams dekhte hain.

items: Amal mein UML: planning (code se pehle requirements aur design), development (banawat aur rishte), rabta (ghair technical stakeholders samet).
